title: Coconut Cove | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the sought-after Prominence neighborhood along 30A, this luxurious four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath beach house offers the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern elegance. Thoughtfully designed for up to 12 guests, its sunlit interiors feature crisp white linens, cheerful decor, and high-end touches such as quartz countertops, a custom wet bar, and a Sonos audio system. Step outside to a private oasis backed by a serene preserve, where a Trex deck invites you to unwind with a six-person Jacuzzi, cozy fire pit, and fairy-lit seating area. The Saber six-burner grill and ample space make outdoor entertaining effortless, while two complimentary bikes allow for easy exploration of 30A’s idyllic surroundings. - Prominence South is a charming coastal community nestled between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach and just 20 minutes to Pier Park. The community features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Residents will enjoy easy access to a beautiful town center, 5,000 square foot resort style pool and fitness center. In the heart of Prominence is The Big Chill (formerly the Hub), a family hot spot for dining, shopping and entertainment, featuring an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which streams major sporting events, movies as well as features live music on their very own stage.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Two Single Over Double Bunks
